items.question: Is Crymad Cash a bank?
items.answer: Crymad Cash is a financial technology platform that provides access to digital financial services through licensed financial partners. We are not a bank, but we work with regulated financial institutions to provide secure and compliant banking-like services.

items.question: Who can open an account?
items.answer: Both individuals and businesses can open Crymad Cash accounts subject to identity verification and compliance checks. We support customers from over 50 countries worldwide.

items.question: What currencies are supported?
items.answer: Crymad Cash supports 100+ fiat currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, and more, as well as popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), and USD Coin (USDC).

items.question: Are my funds secure?
items.answer: Yes. Crymad Cash uses AES-256 encryption, multi-factor authentication, and real-time transaction monitoring to protect your account. We comply with international financial standards and employ advanced fraud detection systems.

items.question: Can I send international payments?
items.answer: Absolutely. Crymad Cash enables global transfers and cross-border payments to 50+ countries with competitive exchange rates and fast processing times across all supported currencies.
